name: Dr. Tapaswi Krishna Kattragada
verified_role: Consultant Transplant Pulmonologist (Pulmonology / Heart & Lung Transplant), Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad
hni_signals: Consultant Transplant Pulmonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, part of the hospital's Heart & Lung Transplant program - a rare, high-value subspecialty focused on lung transplantation and regenerative medicine. 19 years of experience. Medical Registration No. 56944. Qualifications MBBS (Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore), MD Pulmonary Medicine (Narayana Medical College, Nellore), FICCM (Fellowship in Critical Care Medicine, Apollo Hospitals), and PGDLT / Post Graduate Diploma in Lung Transplantation (EHEA) from the Medical University of Vienna, Austria - an international transplant credential. Previously Consultant Transplant Pulmonologist at Gleneagles Fortis Hospitals (2015-2026) and Consultant Pulmonologist at Kamineni Hospitals; former Assistant Professor of Pulmonology, Narayana Medical College. Member of the International Society for Heart & Lung Transplantation, the European Respiratory Society, the Indian Chest Society and the Chest Council of India.
